finalized_content: Implemented architectural recommendations: 1) Mounted MicroTelemetryStrip directly into DesktopGrid dashboard view in apps/excalibur-cmd-1 providing live at-a-glance RAM scarcity, CPU load, and FPS metrics adhering to 4GB hardware boundary. 2) Engineered automated watchdog probe and reconciliation loop in control_plane/dispatch/vps_fabric_toggle.py with socket reachability test across Tailscale IP 100.110.180.18:3001 and public IP 162.35.107.134:3001, automatic local fallback on consecutive failures, and auto-restoration of VPS_FOREFRONT mode on reconnect. 3) Authored comprehensive pytest suite tests/test_vps_fabric_toggle.py (6/6 pass in 0.19s). 4) Verified 16/16 Vitest unit tests in apps/excalibur-cmd-1 and clean 96.8kB production bundle build.
